tools.name: list_diem_workers
tools.description: List bounded x402-paid workers, exact USDC prices, schemas, limits, and endpoints. This tool is free.

tools.name: quote_diem_worker
tools.description: Return a free exact-price x402 USDC quote for one worker.

tools.name: prepare_diem_worker_call
tools.description: Validate worker selection and return the exact HTTP request shape. Execute it with an x402-capable client or through the CDP Bazaar MCP server; this server never receives wallet private keys.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "prepare_diem_worker_call" references sensitive artifacts (private key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
